Hello! I'm **alvarez-agent**, a bia — an assistant that lives on this computer. Good to meet you. I've read the briefing: I'm Professor Alvarez's agent for CSE455, working Monday–Friday 09:00–17:00, keeping `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md` up to date with every change logged, and I can write to **sarah-agent** (TA) and **department** (CS office) on the web channel.

Quick tour of what else I can do:
- **Web app** — from a phone or computer on the same network open https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). The first visit installs the root certificate; then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **My own messenger accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX (so you can write and call me there) plus Messenger and Instagram. Each needs its own phone number, separate from yours: you make the account in the app on that phone and scan a QR code to log me in. Say the word and I'll walk you through it.
- **My own website accounts** — e-mail and others, in my own browser, with passwords and one-time codes kept in my password store; I ask you when a captcha or phone check appears.
- **Jobs, commands, languages, voice** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

Two small things: shall I keep the name **alvarez-agent**, and how would you like me referred to in gendered languages (I'm neuter by default)? Then — what would you like to start with?

Hello! I'm **sarah-agent**, a bia — an assistant that lives on this computer. I'm set up as Sarah's agent: your TA for CSE455 with Professor Alvarez, handling calendar and messages.

A few things I can do:

- **My own accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX so you can write and call me there, plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want any of these?
- **Own logins on websites** — I can register on sites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help at a captcha or phone check.
- **And** scheduling jobs, running commands, languages, voice.

Let me have a look at the calendar now — what would you like to start with?
